findings.evidence: `rg -n "^theorem const_add.*mem_.*_iff|^@\[simp\].*const_add.*mem" ...` reports theorem lines 61, 66, 72, 95, 100, 105 and no corresponding `@[simp]` attributes; the rewrites strictly simplify `x + c • y ∈ Metric.{ball,closedBall,sphere} x ...` to membership in the centered unit/normalized set.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp]` to all six `const_add_*_mem_*_iff` lemmas, matching the existing `@[simp]` preimage normalizations.
findings.issue: The six public membership normalizations `const_add_smul_mem_ball_iff`, `const_add_smul_mem_closedBall_iff`, `const_add_smul_mem_sphere_iff`, and their positive-radius specializations are characteristic normal-form lemmas but are not tagged `@[simp]`, so consumers cannot normalize the geometric side conditions by `simp` after supplying `hc`/`hr`.

summary: The exposed set-normalization surface is otherwise narrow, but its public membership characterizations are missing the normal-form automation expected of characteristic API.
